units.source_text: 宫中为了皇上行幸朱雀院，今天要议定种种事情。

en.t: At court today, various matters had to be settled in preparation for the Emperor's visit to Suzaku-in.

units.source_text: 因此源氏公子整天滞留宫中。

en.t: For that reason, Prince Genji remained at court all day.

units.source_text: 他想起常陆亲王家那位小姐，觉得很可怜，应该写封信去慰问。

en.t: He thought of the young lady of Prince Hitachi's household, felt sorry for her, and decided that he ought to write a letter to comfort her.

units.source_text: 这信直到傍晚才派人送去。

en.t: The letter was not sent by messenger until evening.

units.source_text: 此时天下雨了，路途难行，源氏公子就懒得再到小姐那里去宿夜了。

en.t: By then it was raining and the roads were difficult, so Prince Genji no longer felt inclined to go spend the night with the young lady.

units.source_text: 小姐那里呢，早上就等候来信。

en.t: At the young lady's residence, they had been waiting for a letter since morning.
They waited and waited, but it simply did not come.

units.source_text: 连大辅命妇也很气愤，怨恨源氏公子无情。

en.t: Even Taifu no Myobu was deeply angry and resented Prince Genji for his heartlessness.

units.source_text: 小姐本人想起昨夜之事只觉得可耻。

en.t: The young lady herself, thinking back on what had happened the night before, felt only shame.

units.source_text: 应该早上来的信，到了傍晚才来，反而使得她们手足无措了。

en.t: The letter that should have arrived in the morning came only in the evening, and this left them all the more at a loss.
